werewolf.waitingNight: 🌙 Night has fallen. Wait for dawn...
werewolf.waitingDiscussion: 💬 Discuss and find the wolves! Vote phase in {{s}}s.
werewolf.investigateResultSafe: ✅ This player is NOT a wolf.
werewolf.descSheriff: Investigate one player each night. Your vote counts double.
werewolf.descHunter: Mark a target each night. If you die, they die too.
werewolf.descWitch: One save potion and one poison potion.
werewolf.descCupid: Pair two players on the first night.
werewolf.descLittleGirl: Peek at the wolves each night.
werewolf.descTwoSisters: Learn each other's identity on night 1.
werewolf.descThreeBrothers: Learn each other's identity on night 1.
werewolf.descStutteringJudge: Once per game, trigger a second vote.
werewolf.descRustyKnight: The wolf that bites you dies the next day.
werewolf.descDevotedServant: Inherit the role of the player you follow.
werewolf.descWildChild: If your model dies, you become a werewolf.
werewolf.descIdiot: Voted out? Survive but lose your vote forever.
werewolf.descDrunk: Your actions may miss early on.
werewolf.descWolfCub: When you die, wolves get two kills next night.
werewolf.descDogWolf: Choose your side at the start of the game.
werewolf.descBigBadWolf: Get an extra kill while the pack is strong.
werewolf.descWolfFather: Once per game, convert a victim into a wolf.
werewolf.descHiddenWolf: Appear as innocent to the Seer for 3 rounds.
werewolf.descWolfSorcerer: Disable one player's ability (up to 2 times).
werewolf.descThief: On night 1, steal one of two face-down roles.
werewolf.descCursed: Bitten by wolves? Become one instead of dying.
werewolf.descAvenger: When you die, drag an enemy down with you.
werewolf.descActor: When your target dies, inherit their role.
werewolf.descWhiteWolf: Kill a wolf every 2 nights. Win as the last one standing.
werewolf.descAngel: Win by being bitten night 1 or hanged day 1.
werewolf.descElder: Survive the first wolf bite. Village loses powers if you're hanged.
